scripts.build:dev: node scripts/check-dev-toolchain.ts && turbo run @intloom/cli#build && node apps/cli/scripts/install-dev-cli.ts
scripts.check: node scripts/check-dev-toolchain.ts && biome check . && bun run typecheck && node --test test/engineering/*.test.*
scripts.test: turbo run @intloom/cli#build && bun run --workspaces --if-present test && node --test test/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test && bun run test:e2e
